title: 第187章 仙界布局图第186章 红色怪物
slug: 修仙回来后我儿孙满堂了
content_zh:
第187章仙界布局图
莫不是这怪物已经发现了他的存在？
刚刚在无意之间郁凡已经看到那红色的怪物。
那所谓的红色怪物，实际上更像是一个红色的石头人。
但他的身上似乎隐隐有泛动岩浆的光泽。
结合这里的环境，郁凡合理的怀疑，这个石头人分明就是由岩浆组成的。
那这个怪物极有可能便是为了守护这个红色地方的某样物品而存在的。
他隐隐约约觉得应该是与这山洞里的物品有关系。
继续朝着山洞走进去。
这山洞极深，似乎快走到了山的中心。
郁凡已经能够感受到他的保护罩似乎快要失去了效用了。
现在是连保护罩也抵挡不住这里的炎热了。
并且这罩子又已经开始有了融化的趋势。
果然不出郁凡所料不一会儿保护照片直接化作了碎片，散落在空气中。
没有了仙气罩的保护，郁凡身上的皮肤瞬间被烫出了几个大泡。
烧灼的痛苦不断的出现在他的身上。若不是他毅力坚定，真的会忍不住原路返回。
很显然，那巨大的红色石头人，他并没有过来。
不知道究竟是在忌惮着什么。
于是郁凡顶着满头的水泡，继续朝着。前方流动的岩浆而去。
是的，路的尽头是岩浆。

现在的郁凡可以说是可笑极了，原本就光秃秃的头，如今满是包，看上去，有点像一个癞蛤蟆似的。
然而他依然咬牙坚持着，即使再痛苦，也不过是闷哼几声。
不能放弃，感觉到那岩浆里面分明有他想要的东西。
越朝着岩浆而去，郁凡越能够感受到他的身体似乎快要燃烧了起来，甚至连五脏六腑都有一种燃烧的感觉，连呼吸都已经不再顺畅了。
总算是站在了岩浆旁边，他一刻也不想再犹豫，直接跳入了岩浆当中。
郁凡感受到他的身体似乎已经融化了。
此时的他已经没有了肉体，只有元神依然在岩浆里，不断的被岩浆灼烧着，炙烤着。
然而也正是在这岩浆中郁凡的元神不断地受到了岩浆的洗礼，反而更加凝实。
在不知过了多少时，郁凡总算是清醒了过来。
猛然间睁开的双眼间，似乎有红金色的光芒闪烁。
原来如此。
他在这岩浆中不断的修炼，将岩浆里面所有的力量都吸收一空，凝入了自己的元神之中。
如今的他已经成了这片红色土地的主人。
自然也清楚了这片土地的所有事情。
和他之前所想的居然没有多大差别，这里还真的是神界中的某个上神不小心踢翻了火炉造成的。
错误既然已经造成，上神为了弥补这片仙界，于是将这其中的流岩之火化作了一个巨人，并将仙界的所有资料都放入在一块金色卷轴上，并让巨人守护着它，为此片仙界的后来者提供仙界的信息。
郁凡之所以能够感受到这片土地会对他有用，也正是因为那上神的设置，会让第一个成为仙的人寻找到有用的资料以用于仙界的开荒。
content_en:
Chapter 187 Fairyland Layout
Could it be that this monster has discovered his existence?
Yu Fan had just seen the red monster unintentionally.
The so-called red monster is actually more like a red stone man.
But there seemed to be a faint sheen of flowing magma on his body.
Considering the environment here, Yu Fan reasonably suspected that this stone man was clearly made of magma.
Then this monster most likely exists to protect something in this red place.
He vaguely felt that it must be related to the items in the cave.
Continue walking towards the cave.
This cave is extremely deep and seems to be almost reaching the center of the mountain.
Yu Fan could already feel that his protective shield was about to lose its effectiveness.
Now even the protective cover can't withstand the heat here.
And the cover has begun to melt again.
As expected by Yu Fan, after a while the protective photo turned into pieces and scattered in the air.
Without the protection of the immortal energy mask, several big blisters appeared on Yu Fan's skin in an instant.
The burning pain kept appearing on his body. If it weren't for his perseverance, he really wouldn't be able to help but go back the way he came.
Obviously, the huge red stone man did not come over.
I don't know what I am afraid of.
So Yu Fan continued to move forward with blisters all over his head. Go away from the flowing magma ahead.
Yes, there is lava at the end of the road.
Now Yu Fan can be said to be extremely ridiculous. His originally bald head is now covered with bumps, making him look a bit like a toad.
However, he still gritted his teeth and persisted, no matter how painful it was, he could only groan a few times.
He couldn't give up, feeling that there was clearly something he wanted in the magma.
The further he went towards the magma, the more Yu Fan could feel that his body was about to burn. Even his internal organs had a burning feeling, and even his breathing was no longer smooth.
Finally standing next to the magma, he didn't want to hesitate for a moment and jumped directly into the magma.
Yu Fan felt that his body seemed to have melted.
At this time, he no longer had a physical body, and only his soul was still in the magma, constantly being burned and roasted by the magma.
However, it was in this magma that Yu Fan's soul was constantly being baptized by the magma, and became more solid.
After an unknown amount of time passed, Yu Fan finally came to his senses.
There seemed to be a red-gold light shining between the eyes that suddenly opened.
I see.
He continued to practice in this magma, absorbing all the power in the magma and condensing it into his own soul.
Now he has become the master of this red land.
Naturally, I also understood everything about this land.
It was not much different from what he had thought before. This place was really caused by a god in the God Realm accidentally kicking over the stove.
Now that the mistake had been made, in order to make up for this fairy world, God turned the fire of the flowing rock into a giant, put all the information about the fairy world on a golden scroll, and asked the giant to guard it, so as to provide information about the fairy world to the newcomers to this fairy world.
The reason why Yu Fan could feel that this land would be useful to him was precisely because the God's arrangement would allow the first person to become an immortal to find useful information for the creation of the immortal world.
